line: 毕竟，明天又是新的一天。
original: After all, tomorrow is another day.

line: 我会给他一个无法拒绝的条件。
original: I'm gonna make him an offer he can't refuse.

line: 我本来可以出人头地的。
original: I coulda been a contender.

line: 没有什么地方比得上家。
original: There's no place like home.

line: 我们永远拥有巴黎。
original: We'll always have Paris.

line:
好了，德米尔先生，
我准备好拍特写了。
original:
All right, Mr. DeMille,
I'm ready for my close-up.

line: 愿原力与你同在。
original: May the Force be with you.

line:
系好安全带，
今晚会是个颠簸的夜晚。
original:
Fasten your seatbelts.
It's going to be a bumpy night.

line: 你在跟我说话吗？
original: You talkin' to me?

line: 爱就是永远不必说抱歉。
original: Love means never having to say you're sorry.

line: 那是构成梦的材料。
original: The stuff that dreams are made of.

line: E.T. 打电话回家。
original: E.T. phone home.

line: 是美女杀死了野兽。
original: It was Beauty killed the Beast.

line: 我是邦德，詹姆斯·邦德。
original: Bond. James Bond.

line: 你需要一条更大的船。
original: You're gonna need a bigger boat.

line: 我会回来的。
original: I'll be back.

line:
妈妈说，人生就像一盒巧克力，
你永远不知道下一块是什么味道。
original:
My mama always said life was like a box of chocolates.
You never know what you're gonna get.

line: 你一开口，我就被你打动了。
original: You had me at hello.

line: 你把它建起来，他就会来。
original: If you build it, he will come.

line: 嗯，人无完人。
original: Well, nobody's perfect.

line: 玫瑰花蕾。
original: Rosebud.

line: 我们有时都会有点疯狂。
original: We all go a little mad sometimes.

line:
亲近你的朋友，
更要亲近你的敌人。
original:
Keep your friends close,
but your enemies closer.

line: 休斯顿，我们遇到麻烦了。
original: Houston, we have a problem.

line: 你跳，我也跳。
original: You jump, I jump.

line:
希望是美好的，也许是人间至善，
而美好的事物永不消逝。
original:
Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things,
and no good thing ever dies.

line:
抓住今天，孩子们，
让你们的生命超凡脱俗。
original:
Carpe diem. Seize the day, boys.
Make your lives extraordinary.

line:
不管你将来做什么，都要爱它，
就像你小时候爱放映室那样。
original: Whatever you end up doing, love it.

line:
陆地？对我来说，
陆地是一艘太大的船。
original: Land? Land is a ship too big for me.

line:
人生总是这么痛苦吗？
还是只有小时候是这样？
——总是如此。
original:
Is life always this hard,
or is it just when you're a kid?
Always like this.

line: 这不是你的错。
original: It's not your fault.

line:
假如再也见不到你，
祝你早安、午安、晚安。
original:
In case I don't see ya,
good afternoon, good evening, and good night!

line: 罗马！无论如何，是罗马。
original: Rome! By all means, Rome.

line:
如果你跳错了，缠在一起了，
那就继续跳下去。
original:
If you make a mistake, get all tangled up,
just tango on.

line: 早安，公主！
original: Buongiorno, principessa!

line: 救一人，即救全世界。
original: Whoever saves one life saves the world entire.

line:
他们可以夺走我们的生命，
但永远夺不走我们的自由！
original:
They may take our lives,
but they'll never take our freedom!

line:
我们生前的所作所为，
将在永恒中回响。
original: What we do in life echoes in eternity.

line:
我们唯一能决定的，
是如何利用被赋予的时间。
original:
All we have to decide is what to do
with the time that is given to us.
filmEnglish: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring

line: 根本没有勺子。
original: There is no spoon.

line: 路？我们要去的地方，不需要路。
original: Roads? Where we're going, we don't need roads.

line: 如果你有梦想，就要守护它。
original: You got a dream, you gotta protect it.

line: 记住你是谁。
original: Remember who you are.

line: 飞向宇宙，浩瀚无垠！
original: To infinity and beyond!

line: 冒险就在那里！
original: Adventure is out there!

line: 为什么这么严肃？
original: Why so serious?

line: 别害怕把梦做得更大一点，亲爱的。
original:
You mustn't be afraid to dream
a little bigger, darling.

line: 能力越大，责任越大。
original: With great power comes great responsibility.

line:
沉湎于梦想而忘记生活，
是没有好处的。
original:
It does not do to dwell on dreams
and forget to live.
filmEnglish: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone

line:
敬那些做梦的人，
哪怕他们看起来有点傻。
original:
Here's to the ones who dream,
foolish as they may seem.

line:
曾经发生过的事情不可能忘记，
只不过是想不起来而已。
english:
Nothing that happens is ever forgotten,
even if you can't remember it.

line:
我们曾经仰望星空，
思考自己在星辰间的位置。
original:
We used to look up at the sky and wonder
at our place in the stars.

line: 不要温和地走进那个良夜。
original: Do not go gentle into that good night.

line:
所有这些时刻，终将消逝在时光中，
一如雨中的泪水。
original:
All those moments will be lost in time,
like tears in rain.

line: 抱歉，戴夫，恐怕我做不到。
original: I'm sorry, Dave. I'm afraid I can't do that.

line:
如果宇宙中只有我们，
那真是太浪费空间了。
original:
If it's just us,
it seems like an awful waste of space.

line:
如果你能从头到尾看清自己的一生，
你会改变什么吗？
original:
If you could see your whole life from start to finish,
would you change things?

line: 念念不忘，必有回响。
english:
What you never forget
will always echo back.

line:
如果记忆也是一个罐头的话，
我希望这一个罐头不会过期。
english:
If memories could be canned,
I hope this can would never expire.

line:
说的是一辈子！差一年、一个月、
一天、一个时辰，都不算一辈子！
english:
I mean a lifetime! Not a year, a month,
a day or even an hour less!

line:
这世界上有一种鸟是没有脚的，
它只可以一直飞呀飞，
飞累了就在风里面睡觉。
english:
There's a kind of bird without legs.
It can only fly and fly,
and when it's tired it sleeps in the wind.

line:
那个时代已过去，
属于那个时代的一切，都不存在了。
english:
That era has passed.
Nothing that belonged to it exists anymore.

line:
当你不能够再拥有的时候，
你唯一可以做的，就是令自己不要忘记。
english:
When you can no longer have something,
the only thing you can do is not forget.

line: 对不起，我是警察。

如果非要在这份爱上加一个期限，
我希望是……一万年。
filmEnglish: A Chinese Odyssey Part Two: Cinderella
english:
If I must put a time limit on this love,
I hope it is… ten thousand years.

line: 让子弹飞一会儿。
english: Let the bullets fly a while.

line:
把手握紧，里面什么也没有；
把手松开，你拥有的是一切。
english:
Clench your fist and there's nothing in it.
Open your hand and you hold everything.

line:
不管最终结果将人类历史导向何处，
我们决定，选择希望。
english:
Wherever this leads human history,
we have chosen hope.
